meta.title: Social Media Manager Job, Kado Estate, Abuja | Traction Outsourcing
meta.description: Social Media Manager job in Kado Estate, Abuja at ₦150,000/month. Full-time role with a real estate company. Content creation, video editing and social media skills. Apply online at Traction Outsourcing Limited.
meta.image_alt: Smiling bearded man in a beige coat and turtleneck beside the Traction Outsourcing logo and an Apply Now button, for the Social Media Manager job

hero.headline: Social Media Manager
hero.sub: We are hiring a Social Media Manager for a real estate company in Kado Estate, Abuja. Full-time · ₦150,000/month.

lists.heading: Job Description
items: Manage the company's social media pages (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and X) and keep them active and on brand.
Create content, and shoot and edit short videos (including with CapCut), to promote the company's properties.
Run and monitor paid ads where needed, and report on reach and enquiries.
Reply to comments and messages and pass on enquiries to the sales team.

lists.heading: Requirements
items: Good skills in content creation, video editing and social media management.
Comfortable handling the role with little to no supervision.
Able to commute to Kado Estate, Abuja and resume immediately.

sections.heading: Application Form
sections.sub: Please fill in every field. Your CV must be uploaded as a PDF file.
sections.notice: DO NOT APPLY MORE THAN ONCE. DOUBLE APPLICATIONS WILL BE DISQUALIFIED
sections.success_message: Thank you for your application. We will reach out to qualified candidates.
